sloka: राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुस्त्रासं जग्मुस्तथा ऽपरे ।अपरे समरोद्धर्षाद्धर्षमेव प्रपेदिरे ।। ६.४१.९६ ।।।।
transliteration: rākṣasā vismayaṁ jagmustrāsaṁ jagmustathā 'pare ।apare samaroddharṣāddharṣameva prapedire ।। 6.41.96 ।।।।

translations.english: Sushena, a monkey who is difficult to encounter, went around all the four gates just like the moon goes around stars by the order of Sugriva.
